condition_spec.name: haiku-nosub
condition_spec.note: `baseline-nosub` on the cheap model: Haiku 4.5 with the Agent tool removed. It carries NO `--effort` override — Haiku 4.5 does not honour `--effort` (measured: thinking tokens 202 at `low`, 172 at `max`, 690 with the flag absent; Sonnet 5 on the same prompt goes 0 -> 192), so declaring one here would record a treatment that never ran. It therefore takes the harness default exactly as `haiku-baseline` does, which is what makes that pair a single-variable comparison.

argv:
Users are getting notified about their own actions: comment on an issue you are assigned to and you immediately receive a notification telling you that a comment was added. It should go to the other watchers and not to you. Find the cause and fix it.

This is a `fix` task: edit the code and stop. Do not write a summary and do not emit an ANSWER line.
